rationale: hammernik_vn-claude-agentic: vn_T=5, vn_n_filters=24, vn_kernel=11, vn_n_bumps=31, vn_x_range=1.0, vn_lambda_init=0.0023, vn_init=fbp, vn_dc_norm=True, vn_checkpoint=True, vn_normalize_filters=False, epochs=10, batch_size=2, lr=0.0005, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=200, val_n=214, max_train_s=1000, seed=42, rationale=hammernik_vn iter-2 (search-20260619-01). ONE KNOB: vn_n_filters 16->24 (all else held: vn_T=5, vn_kernel=11, vn_n_bumps=31, lr=5e-4, batch_size=2, vn_checkpoint=true, grad_clip=1.0, vn_dc_norm=true, vn_lambda_init=2.3e-3, max_train_s=1000, train_n=200, val_n=214, seed=42). DIAGNOSIS from iter-1 SLURM log (765196): training CONVERGED by epoch 3 (loss 5.2e-6 ep3 -> 1.6e-6 ep7, asymptotically flat; wall tripped at ep7/14 in 1000s), and the VN settled at SSIM 0.805 BELOW its own FBP init (baseline SSIM ~0.84, baseline_PSNR 34.08). This is a CONVERGED-BUT-BAD basin, NOT under-training -- so epochs-up is INERT here (the proven epochs lever applied to genuinely under-trained trainers; this one has flat loss). lambda_t never moved from init (0.0023 across all 5 steps), so the tiny-DC + 16-filter regulariser converged to a BLUNT SMOOTHER that degrades the FBP init below baseline. Per the brief conditional (epochs-up if budget allows, ELSE vn_n_filters or lr): training is converged AND near the wall -> capacity knob. vn_n_filters 16->24 (the solver default capacity) gives the learned filter bank enough degrees of freedom to learn an EDGE-PRESERVING regulariser instead of the smoothing it collapsed to with 16 filters. NOT touching lr (campaign has lr5e-4-optimal / 8e-4-worse on record). HYPOTHESIS: with 24 filters the regulariser can preserve structure rather than smooth, lifting val_ssim ABOVE the iter-1 0.805 and ideally to/above the ~0.84 FBP floor (hr>0). FALSIFIER: if val_ssim stays <=0.81 (still <FBP), the VN family is structurally smoothing-bound at this DC weight regardless of filter count, and iter-3 must instead raise the DC weight (vn_lambda_init) so data-consistency dominates the regulariser. BUDGET: 24 filters ~1.3x the per-step RBF/conv cost; iter-1 did 7 ep in 1000s (143 s/ep) so expect ~5 ep in the 1000s wall -- still >3 (convergence point), so the converged-comparison is fair. Memory safe: vn_checkpoint=true + batch_size=2 keep N_k=24 (the solver memory-fitted default) within the card. max_train_s=1000 unchanged; total ~1300s under the 1800s SLURM kill.
